differentiation_rule.cone_extension: On U including nonzero null points: Q is a submersion (XVI-J prop:q); the i0 boundary value has a single conormal orientation. The off-cone identity continues uniquely as a boundary-value identity in D'(U).

Q_multiplication.cone_extension: Multiplication by the smooth function Q on U; identity on {Q≠0} continues by continuity of the BV pairing.

product_of_powers.cone_extension: Both factors share the same single conormal (XVI-J prop:q); Hörmander product criterion ⇒ the product exists on U. Equality holds because both sides equal the BV of Q^{-a-b}.

product_existence_vs_equality.existence: Wavefront / Hörmander criterion (math-ph/9903028; XVI-J prop:q) establishes that the products of the powers used above *exist* as distributions on U.
product_existence_vs_equality.equality: Existence ≠ equality. Equality is the separate statement that both sides of (D),(Q),(P) are the same BV expression. A smooth residual multiplied by a power of Q can hide a cone-supported term; denominator clearing alone does not rule that out.

cleared_reduction_translates.argument: Both T and K u are built from η, z_μ and powers (Q-i0)^{-n} by applying (D),(Q),(P). The 256-component cleared-polynomial identity shows that the rational function K u − T vanishes identically on {Q≠0} (numer(Q^6(Ku−T))≡0). A rational residual that is identically zero off the cone has unique BV continuation equal to the zero distribution on U: there is no remaining freedom to add a cone-supported term once the off-cone residual is the zero function. Hence Ku = T in D'(U).
cleared_reduction_translates.BV_lemma_role: identifies the rational expressions with BV algebra

lem_BV_rules_on_U.citation_framework: math-ph/9903028 (Brunetti–Fredenhagen microlocal extension; wavefront product existence); XVI-J prop:q (single-conormal BV of Q-i0 on U). Instantiated for powers n=1..6 used by K u.
